Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
This bundle memorializes the heroic defense against the Machine Legion’s march across the Multiverse with one copy of each of the three Showcase: March of the Machine drops. That’s 15 unique showcase cards, each representing a different plane at war with Phyrexia, all in stunning Halo Foil. Get the bundle, join the fight. The Multiverse is counting on you.

Contents:
• 1x Showcase: March of the Machine Vol. 1
• 1x Showcase: March of the Machine Vol. 2
• 1x Showcase: March of the Machine Vol. 3
